questions.q: A group of flamingos is called a flamboyance.

questions.note: Bats can see, and many also use echoes.

questions.q: An ostrich's eye is bigger than its brain.
questions.note: Each eye is about 5 cm wide!

questions.q: Goldfish only have a three-second memory.
questions.note: Goldfish can remember things for months.

questions.q: Sloths can hold their breath longer than dolphins.
questions.note: Sloths can hold it for up to 40 minutes!
